summary: Standard chess vs Stockfish with neutral SCP-2845 ('the Deer', a reality-altering deity) starting on c4. The deer wanders one square at a time, and every 3-5 turns it 'alters reality' by randomly shuffling all pieces within its 1-square radius (its 3x3 zone) among the squares of that zone, which can triple pawns, change a bishop's square colour, interpose pieces or teleport pawns toward promotion. Narrator keeps pushing pieces near the deer in the engine's camp, promotes, and wins in game one with a ladder (rook roller) mate.
rules: Standard chess otherwise; player White vs Stockfish (3600) Black.
Neutral SCP-2845 deer starts on c4 and moves one square (king step) each round; it cannot be captured [inferred].
Every 3 to 5 rounds (random interval), the deer shuffles: all pieces (both colours) in the 3x3 area centred on it are randomly rearranged among the 9 squares of that area (empty squares included).
Shuffling can change piece colour-complex (bishop becomes dark-squared), leave kings in check/capturable, pin pieces, etc.
Capturing the king or checkmate ends the game [inferred: narrator planned to 'take the king for free' after a shuffle].
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish (won with a ladder mate) or capture the king after a shuffle exposes it.
